name: Cross-Cultural Historical Artifacts Collection
description: A comprehensive dataset of historical artifacts spanning multiple civilizations, including Ancient Greek pottery, Mesopotamian antiquities, Tang Dynasty Chinese ceramics, Ancient Egyptian objects, and Japanese Kofun period artifacts. The dataset includes production dates, provenance information, materials, iconography, inscriptions, and detailed descriptive metadata for museum exhibits and research purposes.

recordSet.name: artifacts
recordSet.description: Each row represents a historical artifact from various museum collections, including Greek, Mesopotamian, Chinese, Egyptian, and Japanese cultural contexts.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique artifact identifier from source museum catalog

field.name: Production date
field.description: Human-readable production date range (e.g., '500BC-490BC (circa)', '618-906'). May include qualifiers like 'circa', 'probably', or 'mainly'. BCE dates shown with 'BC' suffix.

field.name: production_year_min
field.description: Earliest estimated production year (BCE as negative, CE as positive). Parsed from the Production date field.

field.name: production_year_max
field.description: Latest estimated production year (BCE as negative, CE as positive). Parsed from the Production date field.

field.name: is_date_range
field.description: Whether the date represents a range (true) or single year (false)

field.name: date_parse_status
field.description: Parsing success status for production date. Values: 'success' (successfully parsed), 'failed' (could not parse), or 'partial' (partially parsed)

field.name: Find spot
field.description: Original findspot or provenance description from museum records. May include qualifiers like 'Excavated/Findspot:', 'Found/Acquired:', or '(said to be from)'

field.name: find_spot_city
field.description: Parsed city or site name from the findspot. May include historic site names (e.g., 'Vulci', 'Naukratis', 'Ur'). Can be null if location couldn't be parsed.

field.name: find_spot_country
field.description: Parsed modern country name from the findspot. Maps historic locations to current countries (e.g., 'Italy', 'Egypt', 'Iraq', 'Greece', 'China', 'Japan', 'Cyprus', 'Libya'). Can be null if location couldn't be parsed.

field.name: location_parse_status
field.description: Parsing status for location fields. Values: 'success' (successfully parsed city and country), 'failed' (could not parse), or 'partial' (only one field parsed)

field.name: Materials
field.description: Primary material(s) used in the artifact's construction (e.g., 'pottery', 'stone', 'bronze', 'earthenware', 'stoneware', 'glazed composition', 'gold', 'cornelian', 'lapis lazuli'). May include compound materials separated by semicolons.

field.name: Technique
field.description: Artistic and manufacturing techniques used (e.g., 'painted', 'incised', 'glazed', 'carved', 'engraved', 'wheel-made', 'mould-made', 'inlaid', 'gilded'). Multiple techniques separated by semicolons. Can be null if not documented.

field.name: Inscription
field.description: Complete inscription metadata including type, position, language, script, transliteration, translation, and notes. Structured as 'Inscription type: [type] Inscription position: [position] Inscription language: [language] Inscription script: [script] Inscription transliteration: [text] Inscription translation: [text] Inscription note: [notes]'. Can be null if no inscription present.

field.name: Subjects
field.description: Iconographic subjects and themes depicted on the artifact (e.g., 'classical deity', 'warrior', 'horse-racing', 'mythical figure/creature', 'satyr', 'lotus', 'sphinx', 'bird', 'mammal'). Multiple subjects separated by semicolons. Can be null if not applicable.

field.name: Assoc name
field.description: Associated figures, deities, or individuals depicted or named in the artifact. Includes representations (e.g., 'Representation of: Athena/Minerva'), named inscriptions (e.g., 'Named in inscription: Amenhotep III'), or associations (e.g., 'Associated with: Lady Layard'). Can be null if none identified.

field.name: Culture
field.description: Cultural attribution or period classification (e.g., 'Attic', 'Archaic Greek', 'Neo-Assyrian', 'Tang dynasty', '26th Dynasty', 'Third Dynasty of Ur', 'Kofun Period', 'Late Minoan I'). May include multiple classifications separated by semicolons.

field.name: Section
field.description: Museum collection section or classification category (e.g., 'Greek', 'Mesopotamian', 'Tang dynasty', 'Ancient Egyptian', 'Japanese')

field.name: Place
field.description: Broad geographical origin or cultural region (e.g., 'Greece', 'iraq', 'China', 'Egypt', 'Japan')

field.name: description
field.description: Comprehensive artifact description including physical characteristics, iconographic analysis, historical context, artistic techniques, and cultural significance. Typically 150-400 words providing detailed scholarly interpretation.

completeness.description: Dataset contains 150 artifacts with varying levels of completeness
completeness.missingValues: Fields 'Inscription', 'Subjects', 'Assoc name', and 'Technique' may be null for artifacts without these features
completeness.parsingStatus: Dates and locations have associated status fields indicating parsing success

preprocessing.description: Data has been preprocessed to extract structured information from museum records
steps: Date parsing: Extract year ranges from textual date descriptions
Location parsing: Extract city and country from findspot descriptions
Date normalization: Convert BCE/BC dates to negative numbers, CE/AD dates to positive
Status tracking: Record parsing success/failure for quality control
